name: 共通照護
intro: 健康的生活習慣可以搭配治療，但不能取代治療。這頁整理六種疾病都可參考的基本生活照護。

cards.title: 規律活動
cards.summary: 多動少坐，每週累積足夠的活動量。
cards.illustration: Three adults of different ages being active: one walking, one doing a strength exercise with a resistance band, and an older adult doing a balance exercise while holding the back of a chair; flat, friendly style; no text, no brands.

points.text: 成人每週累積150到300分鐘中等強度有氧活動，或75到150分鐘高強度有氧活動，或兩者搭配。

evidence.quote: Adults should do at least 150–300 minutes of moderate-intensity aerobic physical activity; or at least 75–150 minutes of vigorous-intensity aerobic physical activity; or an equivalent combination of moderate- and vigorous-intensity activity throughout the week, for substantial health benefits.

All adults should undertake 150-300 min of moderate-intensity, or 75-150 min of vigorous-intensity physical activity, or some equivalent combination of moderate-intensity and vigorous-intensity aerobic physical activity, per week.

Adults and older adults with these chronic conditions should do at least 150–300 minutes of moderate-intensity aerobic physical activity; or at least 75–150 minutes of vigorous-intensity aerobic physical activity; or an equivalent combination of moderate- and vigorous-intensity activity throughout the week for substantial health benefits.
evidence.confidence: High for wording; INDIRECT for RMDs

evidence.quote: World Health Organisation recommendations for a healthy lifestyle are also applicable to people with RMDs

points.text: 每週至少2天做肌力訓練，強度中等以上，並練到全身主要肌群。

evidence.quote: Adults should also do muscle-strengthening activities at moderate or greater intensity that involve all major muscle groups on 2 or more days a week, as these provide additional health benefits.

additional health benefits will occur through participation in muscle-strengthening activities at moderate or greater intensity on 2 or more days a week, a strong recommendation supported by moderate-certainty evidence.

points.text: 65歲以上：做為每週活動量的一部分，每週至少3天做結合平衡和肌力訓練的多元活動，強度中等以上，以增進身體功能、預防跌倒。

evidence.quote: As part of their weekly physical activity, older adults should do varied multicomponent physical activity that emphasizes functional balance and strength training at moderate or greater intensity, on 3 or more days a week, to enhance functional capacity and to prevent falls.

the recommendation regarding multicomponent physical activity that emphasises functional balance and strength training to enhance functional capacity and prevent falls now applies to all older adults rather than specifically those with poor mobility.
High-certainty evidence demonstrates that balance and functional exercises reduce the rate of falls

points.text: 減少久坐。用任何強度的活動取代坐著，即使是輕度活動，也對健康有益。

evidence.quote: Adults should limit the amount of time spent being sedentary. Replacing sedentary time with physical activity of any intensity (including light intensity) provides health benefits.

Adults and older adults with chronic conditions should limit the amount of time spent being sedentary. Replacing sedentary time with physical activity of any intensity (including light intensity) provides health benefits.

points.text: 運動是安全的，任何時候開始都不嫌晚。這項歐洲建議涵蓋痛風、類風濕性關節炎、中軸型脊椎關節炎、紅斑性狼瘡等，未包括乾燥症和蕁麻疹。

evidence.quote: People with RMDs should be advised that exercise is safe and that it is never too late to start exercising
General PA recommendations including the 4 domains (cardiorespiratory fitness, muscular fitness, flexibility, and neuromotor performance) are applicable (feasible and safe) for people with IA and OA.

tip.text: 還做不到這些量時，有動總比沒動好；從少量開始，慢慢增加次數、強度和時間。

evidence.quote: For all populations, doing some physical activity is better than doing none. If individuals are not currently meeting these recommendations, doing some physical activity will bring benefits to health. Individuals should start with small amounts of physical activity and gradually increase frequency, intensity and duration over time.
Doing some physical activity is better than doing none.

cards.title: 戒菸
cards.summary: 有抽菸就建議戒菸，可以請醫療團隊幫忙。
cards.illustration: A hand snapping a cigarette in half while a health professional rests a supportive hand on the person's shoulder; flat, friendly style; no text, no brands.

points.text: 有抽菸習慣的人，建議戒菸。

evidence.quote: People with RMDs should be encouraged to stop smoking and be informed that smoking is detrimental to symptoms, function, disease activity, disease progression and occurrence of comorbidities in all RMDs

points.text: 抽菸對風濕病的症狀、身體功能、病情活動和病情進展都不利，也會讓其他疾病更容易出現。

evidence.quote: People with RMDs should be encouraged to stop smoking and be informed that smoking is detrimental to symptoms, function, disease activity, disease progression and occurrence of comorbidities in all RMDs

points.text: 向醫療人員尋求戒菸協助，並請他們追蹤戒菸進度。

evidence.quote: These people should be offered support to quit and progress towards quitting should be monitored by health professionals. … Smokers should be supported to quit.

cards.title: 體重、飲食與飲酒
cards.summary: 均衡飲食、維持健康體重，飲酒先和醫療人員討論。
cards.illustration: A balanced meal plate with generic, unlabeled food portions beside a bathroom scale, and a patient talking with a health professional; flat, friendly style; no text, no brands, no alcoholic drinks shown.

points.text: 選擇健康、均衡的飲食，這是改善生活習慣的重要一環。

evidence.quote: A healthy, balanced diet is integral to lifestyle improvement for people with RMDs

points.text: 吃某種特定食物，不太可能讓風濕病大幅改善。

evidence.quote: People with RMDs should be informed that consuming specific food types is unlikely to have large benefits for RMD outcomes

points.text: 以維持健康體重為目標。

evidence.quote: People with RMDs should aim for a healthy weight

points.text: 體重過重或肥胖時，和醫療人員合作，用健康飲食和多活動有計畫地減重，可能對風濕病有幫助。

evidence.quote: People with RMDs who are overweight or obese should work with health professionals to achieve controlled and intentional weight loss through healthy diet and increased physical activity as this may be beneficial for RMD outcomes

points.text: 和醫療人員討論自己的飲酒習慣，開始新的治療時更要討論。

evidence.quote: The alcohol consumption of people with RMDs should be discussed together with health professionals, particularly when starting new treatments

tip.text: 痛風或類風濕性關節炎患者要知道：中等量飲酒與病情發作風險增加有關。

evidence.quote: People with rheumatoid arthritis and health professionals should be aware that moderate alcohol consumption is associated with increased risk of rheumatoid arthritis flare and comorbidities
People with gout and health professionals should be aware that moderate alcohol consumption is associated with increased risk of gout flare

cards.title: 類固醇與骨骼保健
cards.summary: 長期口服類固醇，要補足鈣與維生素D、調整生活習慣。
cards.illustration: An adult doing a simple resistance exercise with light hand weights, next to a balanced meal plate and a plain, unlabeled supplement bottle; flat, friendly style; no text, no brands.

points.text: 開始或持續長期口服類固醇（超過3個月）的成人，建議從飲食和補充品補足鈣和維生素D，並調整生活習慣。

evidence.quote: For adults and children beginning or continuing chronic GC at a dose of ≥2.5 mg/day for >3 months, we conditionally recommended optimizing age appropriate dietary and supplemental calcium and vitamin D, in addition to lifestyle modifications … For adults and children beginning or continuing chronic GC treatment at low, moderate, high, or very high risk of fracture, we conditionally recommend optimizing dietary and supplemental calcium and vitamin D in addition to lifestyle modifications.
evidence.strength: Conditional; certainty of evidence "Low or very low" (Table 2; another read gave "Low to very low")

points.text: 成人每天的鈣，飲食加補充品合計，建議攝取到1,000至1,200毫克（以元素鈣計）。

evidence.quote: Dietary and supplemented elemental calcium intake of up to 1,000 to 1,200 mg daily is recommended for adults …
evidence.strength: Part of the conditional recommendation (low/very low certainty)

points.text: 維生素D通常每天需要600到800國際單位，或更多；並應抽血追蹤濃度。

evidence.quote: Serum vitamin D levels should be monitored, and vitamin D supplemented … 600 to 800 IU daily or more is typically required.
evidence.strength: Part of the conditional recommendation (low/very low certainty)

points.text: 規律做負重運動或阻力訓練，均衡飲食，並把體重維持在建議範圍。

evidence.quote: Lifestyle modifications include smoking cessation, limiting alcohol to ≤2 servings a day, eating a balanced diet, maintaining weight in the recommended range, and performing regular weight-bearing or resistance training exercises.
evidence.strength: Part of the conditional recommendation (low/very low certainty)

points.text: 戒菸，並限制飲酒；這不是鼓勵喝酒，能不能喝請和醫師討論。

evidence.quote: Lifestyle modifications include smoking cessation, limiting alcohol to ≤2 servings a day, eating a balanced diet, maintaining weight in the recommended range, and performing regular weight-bearing or resistance training exercises.
evidence.strength: Part of the conditional recommendation (low/very low certainty)
Editorial safety phrase 「這不是鼓勵喝酒，能不能喝請和醫師討論」; ACR's "≤2 servings a day" ceiling is not printed because "serving" is undefined

tip.text: 口服類固醇3個月以上的人，也要盡量降低跌倒的風險。

evidence.quote: General measures are recommended for all patients who are being prescribed GCs for ≥3 months, ie, … and the risk of falls be minimized.
evidence.strength: Strength not found in accessible text

cards.title: 疫苗接種
cards.summary: 治療期間可打非活性疫苗；活性疫苗先問醫師。
cards.illustration: A patient and a doctor reviewing a vaccination record card together at a clinic desk, with a nurse preparing a syringe in the background; flat, friendly style; no text, no brands.

points.text: 自體免疫風濕病患者在使用類固醇或抗風濕藥物期間，仍可接種非活性疫苗；如果可以，最好在開始免疫抑制治療前接種。

evidence.quote: Non-live vaccines can be administered to patients with AIIRD during the use of glucocorticoids and DMARDs
Vaccines should be preferably administered prior to planned immunosuppression, in particular B cell depleting therapy
evidence.strength: S9: not found. S10: text statement.

points.text: 風濕病患者使用免疫抑制藥物期間，活性減毒疫苗建議延後接種；接種前請先問風濕科醫師。

evidence.quote: For patients with RMD who are taking immunosuppressive medication, deferring live attenuated vaccines is conditionally recommended. … the Voting Panel conditionally recommended against administering live attenuated virus vaccines to patients receiving those agents as well as other forms of immunosuppression.
Live-attenuated vaccines may be considered with caution in patients with AIIRD

points.text: 多數自體免疫風濕病患者，都應積極考慮接種流感疫苗和肺炎鏈球菌疫苗。

evidence.quote: Influenza vaccination should be strongly considered for the majority of patients with AIIRD … Pneumococcal vaccination should be strongly considered for the majority of patients with AIIRD

points.text: 正在使用免疫抑制藥物的風濕病患者，即使未滿65歲，也強烈建議接種肺炎鏈球菌疫苗。

evidence.quote: For patients with RMD age <65 years who are taking immunosuppressive medication, pneumococcal vaccination is strongly recommended.

points.text: 超過18歲、正在使用免疫抑制藥物的風濕病患者，強烈建議接種重組帶狀疱疹（皮蛇）疫苗。

evidence.quote: For patients with RMD age >18 years who are taking immunosuppressive medication, administering the recombinant VZV vaccine is strongly recommended.

tip.text: 每年請風濕科團隊檢視一次疫苗紀錄，並和醫師一起決定接種時機。

evidence.quote: The vaccination status and indications for further vaccination in patients with AIIRD should be assessed yearly by the rheumatology team … The former address the need for an annual vaccination status assessment, shared decision-making and timing of vaccination
evidence.strength: Strength not found in accessible text (Table 1 not rendered)

evidence.quote: The individualised vaccination programme should be explained to the patient by the rheumatology team, providing a basis for shared decision-making, and be jointly implemented by the primary care physician, the rheumatology team and the patient
4) shared decision-making with patients is a key component of any vaccination strategy.

cards.title: 看懂紫外線指數
cards.summary: 指數3以上要防護，8以上要加強防護。
cards.illustration: A sun icon above a simple five-step bar of increasing intensity, and a person in the shade of a tree wearing a hat and a shirt while applying sunscreen; flat, friendly style; no text, no numbers, no brands.

points.text: 紫外線指數越高，皮膚和眼睛越容易受傷，受傷所需的時間也越短。

evidence.quote: The UVI is a measure of the level of UV radiation. The values of the index range from zero upward - the higher the UVI, the greater the potential for damage to the skin and eye, and the less time it takes for harm to occur.

points.text: 中央氣象署分級：0–2 低量級、3–5 中量級、6–7 高量級、8–10 過量級、11 以上危險級。
points.strength_label: 中央氣象署・指引說明

evidence.quote: "0-2 低量級" "3-5 中量級" "6-7 高量級" "8-10 過量級" "11+ 危險級" … "紫外線指數分級係依據WHO相關規範"

points.text: 指數3到7需要防護：中午時段找陰涼處，穿上能遮住皮膚的衣物、擦防曬乳、戴帽子。

evidence.quote: "PROTECTION REQUIRED" (UVI 3-7): "Seek shade during midday hours" "Slip on a shirt, slop on sunscreen and slap on a hat"
[3 to 7] "Seek shade during midday hours! Slip on a shirt, slop on sunscreen and slap on hat!"
Above the threshold value of 3, protection is necessary, and this message should be reinforced at UVI values of 8 and above.

points.text: 指數8以上要加強防護：中午時段避免待在戶外，務必找陰涼處，遮住皮膚的衣物、防曬乳、帽子都不能少。

evidence.quote: "EXTRA PROTECTION" (UVI 8+): "Avoid being outside during midday hours" "Make sure you seek shade" "Shirt, sunscreen and hat are a must"
[8 and above] "Avoid being outside during midday hours! Make sure you seek shade! Shirt, sunscreen and hat are a must!"

points.text: 紅斑性狼瘡患者，建議做好防曬，以預防病情發作。

evidence.quote: In people with SLE, photoprotection should be advised for the prevention of flares (LoE: 4) … Photoprotection and psychosocial interventions are important for SLE patients

tip.text: 某些藥物、香水和體香劑會讓皮膚對陽光更敏感，可能嚴重曬傷；可以詢問藥師。

evidence.quote: Taking certain medications as well as using perfumes and deodorants can sensitize your skin, causing serious burns in the sun. Ask your pharmacist for advice.

myths.belief: 運動要一次連續做10分鐘以上才算數。
myths.fact: WHO 2020年指引已取消「至少連續10分鐘」的規定；任何長度的活動都與健康改善有關。

evidence.quote: the previous stipulation that physical activity should be accumulated in at least 10 min bouts has been removed. This change reflects the accumulated evidence from cohort studies, which shows physical activity of any bout duration is associated with improved health outcomes, including all-cause mortality.

myths.belief: 擦了防曬乳，就可以在太陽下待久一點。
myths.fact: 防曬乳不是用來延長曬太陽的時間，而是用來降低曝曬帶來的健康風險。

evidence.quote: Sunscreen should never be used to prolong the duration of sun exposure. … Applying sunscreen is not a means to prolong your stay in the sun but to reduce the health risk of your exposure.

seek_care.text: 增加活動量時如果出現新的症狀，請諮詢醫療人員。

evidence.quote: Those who develop new symptoms when increasing their levels of activity should consult a healthcare provider.

reviewer_notes: ALCOHOL (I changed the suggested card): the reassurance that a low level of alcohol is unlikely to harm except with liver disease or certain treatments (S1 Alcohol 2, common:C51, GoR B) is NOT on the page. On a page shared by all six diseases it would clash with the gout sources: gout:C16 (EULAR 2016 'avoidance of alcohol (especially beer and spirits)'), gout:C13 (ACR 'limiting alcohol intake … regardless of disease activity') and gout:C14 (>1–2 drinks in 24 h linked to a 40% higher flare risk). It would also clash with urticaria:C23 ('Alcohol can aggravate CU'). C51 also had the lowest panel agreement of all 18 S1 recommendations (LoA 8.0; 73.7%), and S1 never quantifies 'low'. I kept the common ground: talk about alcohol with the care team, especially when starting new treatments (C50, point 5), plus S1's RA and gout flare statements (C52/C53) as the tip. If you want C51 back, note that S1's examples of 'certain treatments' are methotrexate and leflunomide; BRIEF rule 7 bars drug names, so the page would have to say 「某些藥物」.

VACCINES, timing conflict: EULAR 2019 prefers vaccinating 'during quiescent disease' (C64), but ACR 2022 conditionally recommends non-live vaccines 'regardless of patients' disease activity' (C73; very low certainty). Neither position is printed. The card's tip has the patient decide timing with the rheumatology team (EULAR C62/C63; ACR shared decision-making, C71). For the same reason I left out ACR's text that flu vaccination 'today' is preferred over delay and should be given even when disease is active (C72).

UV INDEX, cut-off conflict: the WHO 2002 guide says risk is limited 'below a UVI of 3' and prints the low band as '< 2' (Table 1) and '1-2' (Figure 2). The WHO 2022 Q&A says 'below a UVI of 2' and uses '0 to 2'. The card uses the CWA bands (0–2 低量級 …; CWA states its bands follow WHO) and only the advice both WHO documents share: protection at 3–7, extra protection at 8+. It deliberately has no 'no protection needed at 0–2' line, because no UVI threshold for photosensitive patients (e.g. SLE) was found (common M14). The CWA strength label has no year because the page shows none (accessed 2026-10-06). WHO wrote the scheme for fair-skinned people who burn easily (S11 p. 6).

STEROID BONE CARD, population: the ACR 2022 text defines the population as GC ≥2.5 mg/day for >3 months. The patient text uses the ACR Table 2 wording ('beginning or continuing chronic GC treatment') plus 「超過3個月」, and leaves out the 2.5 mg/day threshold because BRIEF rule 7 bars doses. The full ACR wording, including the dose, stays in the evidence quote. If you add the threshold, check in the PDF which steroid it is expressed as; the recorded quote does not say.

Calcium and vitamin D: 'up to 1,000 to 1,200 mg daily' of dietary plus supplemented elemental calcium is rendered 「建議攝取到1,000至1,200毫克（以元素鈣計）」; diet counts, as the ACR text states. 'Up to' could also be read as a ceiling (「最多」); please choose. The vitamin D sentence ('600 to 800 IU daily or more is typically required') follows 'vitamin D supplemented…' and does not say whether diet counts, so the page names no source. Serum 25(OH)D targets are cut from both the text and the quotes; they differ across ACR 2017 (≥20 ng/ml), ACR 2022 (≥30–50 ng/mL) and ECTS 2024 (50–125 nmol/L).

Steroid card alcohol: 'limiting alcohol to ≤2 servings a day' (ACR 2022, C57) is printed as a limit, followed by the EDITORIAL phrase 「這是上限，不是鼓勵喝酒」 (evidence file, Section E9: the figure is a ceiling for GC users, not a 'safe' endorsement). The source does not define 'serving'. The figure may sit uneasily with the gout and RA flare advice. Falls: ACR 2022 has no fall-prevention recommendation (C61); only ECTS 2024 (C59; abstract only, strength not found) gives a fall-risk measure for GC users, so it is the tip.

Disease coverage: S1 (EULAR 2021 lifestyle) covers OA, RA, axSpA, PsA, SLE, SSc and gout. S2 (EULAR 2025 PA) covers inflammatory arthritis (RA, SpA) and OA. Neither covers chronic urticaria or Sjögren's, so card 1 point 5 names the diseases covered. The vaccine sources cover AIIRD (EULAR) and RMD (ACR), not chronic urticaria. WHO activity amounts are for the general population. WHO's chronic-condition evidence (cancer, hypertension, type 2 diabetes, HIV) is indirect for RMDs; S1 overarching principle 3 bridges it (C03, cited on point 1). '65歲以上' comes from the WHO section heading 'Recommendations for older adults (65 years and above)', recorded as the C60 location; the C17 quote itself says 'older adults'.

Smoking: the page does not claim that quitting lowers disease activity (Cochrane, C42/M9: no trial showed it). Point 2 restates S1's own recommendation wording ('smoking is detrimental to …'), which rests on observational evidence (C41; causality cannot be inferred). Point 3 (support to quit) comes from S1's explanatory text and abstract, not the graded Table 1 wording, so it is labelled 指引說明 rather than 建議強度 B. Left for disease pages: RA smoking and drug response (C39) and SLE (C40). C43 (RA-only quit-programme meta-analysis that mentions nicotine replacement) was not used.

Diet and weight: I left out the WHO diet details S1 cites (C45: 'select foods of plant and marine origin', legumes), because they could clash with gout advice to avoid excessive meat and seafood (gout:C25, EULAR 2016). The page gives no BMI numbers: the WHO cut-offs quoted by S1 (C49: ≥25 overweight, ≥30 obese) differ from Taiwan MOHW 2013 (S20: healthy 18.5≦BMI<24, overweight 24≦BMI<27, obese BMI≧27; single read, no C-ID, dated 2013). If you want numbers, use Taiwan's after checking for a newer HPA statement.

Zoster, pneumococcal and influenza vaccines: the card states ACR 2022's strong zoster recommendation (age >18 on immunosuppression). It is newer and broader than EULAR 2019 ('may be considered in high-risk patients'). The Taiwan IDST zoster guidance (S21, endorsed by the Taiwan College of Rheumatology) could not be checked (abstract only). The recorded quotes never say the recombinant zoster vaccine is non-live; consider adding 「（非活性疫苗）」 after checking. ACR's strong pneumococcal recommendation covers only age <65 on immunosuppression (ACR is complementary to ACIP, C71). Older patients are covered only by EULAR's 'majority of patients with AIIRD' point, so consider adding Taiwan's adult pneumococcal schedule from a local source. Left out: ACR's conditional preference for high-dose or adjuvanted flu vaccine (age ≥65, or >18 and <65 on immunosuppression), because availability in Taiwan was not checked.

Live-vaccine quote (C77): the PMC text drops the word 'deferring'. The evidence uses the ACR-hosted manuscript wording, and the intact Discussion sentence ('conditionally recommended against administering live attenuated virus vaccines') confirms the direction. Both are quoted.

Strength labels where the grade was not accessible: EULAR 2019 influenza and pneumococcal (C68, 'should be strongly considered'), EULAR 2024 SLE photoprotection (C89, SoR not found, 'should be advised') and ECTS 2024 falls (C59, 'are recommended') are labelled 「建議」 because the quotes use recommendation language.
